instruction: Open character.png from the Desktop in GIMP and resize it to 640x640 pixels. Export the result as resized_large.png on the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent installed mattn.lisp extension in VS Code successfully, wrote Script-Fu resize code, opened GIMP and Script-Fu console, but failed to produce resized.png output file within 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VS Code UI, search and install extensions from marketplace, open GIMP, navigate GIMP menus, use Script-Fu console, open images in GIMP
metadata.failure_analysis: Model successfully installed the lisp extension (part 1) but failed to execute the Script-Fu resize script and save the output (part 2). Spent too many turns navigating between GIMP and VS Code without producing resized.png.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed to test only the GIMP image resize capability. Removes the VS Code/Script-Fu requirement, allowing the model to use any GIMP method (menu, Script-Fu, or Python-Fu) to resize. Slightly easier target size (640x640) than the original 128x128.
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening character.png (1280x1280) in GIMP, resizing to 640x640, and exporting as resized_large.png. Evaluator uses check_image_size metric with vm_file getter to verify output dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches /home/user/Desktop/resized_large.png via vm_file, matching the instruction's export path
Metric check_image_size correctly receives {width: 640, height: 640} as the rule parameter (get_rule returns config['rules'] directly) and compares against actual image dimensions
Expected values 640x640 match the instruction requirement exactly
File existence is implicitly verified since the getter returns None if the file doesn't exist, causing the metric to return 0

Minor gap: evaluator only checks output dimensions, not that the image content originates from character.png (a different 640x640 image would pass). This is an acceptable common pattern but prevents full semantic verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a structure similarity check (e.g., check_structure_sim_resized) against the original character.png to verify the output image content is derived from the source image
Config launches 'code' (VS Code) instead of GIMP - consider changing to launch GIMP for consistency with the instruction
